findings: ZIP 07620 (Alpine) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07620 (Alpine) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
